conditional.completionLogic: If bounded reaches quantity10, false-stop/lost-completion are zero by definition, not an observed uncapped pair or proof of no P5 action. Every shortfall gets a new production twin.
conditional.trigger: bounded or matching frozen row: <10, set no-window/bound, any budget stop, reserve/work/host clock cut; absent required telemetry is unknown, never zero
conditional.exhaustion: Never drop a required twin. More than15 is a finding/reprice within the approved predicate and remaining grant; if unfunded, stop and mark incomplete.
